source: synthetic; from the chalk@5.3.0 pilot reconciliation (docs/release-risk-pilot.md) — vendored files reached only through the package.json imports map read as unreachable
license: MIT — synthetic fixture; no upstream code copied
rationale: A file resolved through the node condition of the # subpath imports map is reachable and must not be flagged; the sibling reachable only via the default condition (browser-only) genuinely is unreachable from a Node entry. The pre-fix behavior produced false positives on every package that vendors this way; 'since' is 'unreleased' until the fix ships in a version, then bumped in the same PR as the release.
limitations: Only the node/default conditions are resolved; exotic custom conditions still read as unreachable.
